items: Vehicle emission standards: enforced to reduce pollution from motor vehicles, with promotion of cleaner fuels such as compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) and stricter regulation of fuel quality.
Industrial emission control: reducing emissions from industrial sources and encouraging industries to adopt cleaner production techniques and pollution-control technologies.

Public awareness campaigns: educating the public about the sources and effects of air pollution and ways to reduce personal contributions, and promoting public transport, car-pooling and non-motorised transport such as cycling and walking.
Urban planning and green infrastructure: developing green belts and parks in urban areas, and planning to reduce traffic congestion and promote sustainable transport.

Smog control measures: specific measures, particularly in the winter months when air quality deteriorates, including restrictions on the burning of crop residues, a major contributor to smog, and the use of smog towers and other technologies to reduce particulate matter.
Prohibition of open fires for disposing of domestic and industrial waste, which produce dust, smoke and large amounts of pollutants.
Use of low-sulfur diesel: reduction of the permissible level of sulfur in diesel.

blocks.text: Through these regulations and measures Pakistan aims to improve air quality and minimise the adverse effects of air pollution on public health and the environment.

blocks.prompt: What are the specific measures to control smog (exercise Q.2k)?
blocks.explanation: Winter-focused measures: banning the burning of crop residues, which contributes heavily to smog; operating smog towers and other particulate-removing technologies; enforcing vehicle emission standards and cleaner fuels; controlling industrial and brick-kiln emissions; prohibiting open burning of waste; and warning the public to limit exposure on high-smog days.

items: Measures: vehicle emission standards and cleaner fuels (CNG, LPG); industrial emission control; public awareness and public transport; green belts and urban planning; smog control (crop-residue bans, smog towers); no open burning of waste; low-sulfur diesel.
